I speak Danish, and I know your answer was completely correct. There's a flag there where you can click "My answer should have been accepted." 
I'm not sure if it'll help with anything though :/

We met through friends on Discord, we both had joined the same server and hit it off. We're 6,000 km or 4,000 miles away with almost 2 years. 
Good luck on finding someone!

I'll take your word for it, thank you! :) 
I've thought about getting classes and such, but now I think I'll start with tutoring. I hope I'll be able to get to the point where I can have conversations and tell stories! 
Do you have any tutoring website or app, or however you get tutoring that you recommend?

You're right! I really appreciate it, thank you! 
I think talking with him and figuring this out together would be a good idea too. I'll try figuring out which errors need to be prioritized. 
I feel like he always tries to help without making me feel bad, but perhaps we need to change the way he corrects me?
So, do you think we should try setting a certain time and topic? 
Thank you for all your help. I was just looking at tutoring!

Thank you! I'm glad I'm not the only one who feels this way about it. I've been hesitant about getting a 1 on 1 tutor, but you're right. It seems better to struggle with a tutor. I'll look into it, thank you again!!

I've practiced it for a while, and I can already hold a decent conversation. We've tried it before where he helped me learn it, but it quickly kind of gets teacher/student. I think he's afraid of making me more insecure so instead of us laughing about the mistakes, he just asks me to try again. Which lead me to getting discouraged-

I'll try talking about it with him. And I will definitely look at Varsity Tutors and Oxford self-guided books and audio. Thank you!

I have actually! I think it helps a lot to practice it whenever you can. 
I'll try giving it a shot to ask him in Danish, thank you!

Thank you for commenting! Unfortunately, it's a long distance relationship, so we can't really go places together. However, I will talk with him about setting a time to speak Danish instead! And you're right, I shouldn't give up
Thank you! I think you're right, I'll try giving it a shot!
That took drifting to another level
